    🕹️ Description

    Pocket Era R36H Pro Retro Handheld Console

    The R36H Pro is the landscape handheld in the Pocket Era line. A 3.5 inch HD IPS screen at 640 x 480, dual lit joysticks for comfortable control, and an RK3566 64-bit quad-core chip behind it. 20,000+ games preloaded across 10+ systems, ready to play out of the box.

    Why the R36H Pro

    Held sideways. A wide, comfortable grip for long sessions.

    Two real joysticks. Lit analog sticks for the games that need them.

    Faster chip. The RK3566 runs heavier systems more smoothly.

    USB-C charging. Built-in 3000mAh battery.

    Six finishes

    Five of the six shells are transparent (Smoke, Purple, Blue, Red and Orange) and show the board and the lit sticks straight through the case, the way the clear consoles of the 90s did. White is a clean solid finish if you would rather keep it covered.

    Choose your storage

    64GB
    15,000+ games preloaded

    128GB
    20,000+ games preloaded

    Add your own games

    Plug the included memory card into a computer and drag your games in. They show up in the menu right away. Only add games you own.

    Specs

    CPU: RK3566 64-bit quad-core
    Display: 3.5 inch HD IPS, 640 x 480
    Battery: 3000mAh, up to 5 hours of play
    Storage: 64GB or 128GB microSD
    Games: 15,000+ (64GB) or 20,000+ (128GB) preloaded, 10+ systems
    Controls: Dual analog joysticks with lit rings, D-pad, face buttons, shoulder buttons
    Audio: Built-in speaker and 3.5mm headphone jack
    OS: Open-source Linux

    🚀 Features

    15,000+ classic games preloaded (40,000+ on the 128GB bundles), spanning 21+ retro systems from NES and SNES to Game Boy, PS1 and PSP
    Add your own games: the library lives on the microSD card, so you can plug it into a computer and drag and drop your own game files into the matching system folder
    Bright 3.5 inch IPS screen (640x480) with classic D-pad controls
    RK3326 quad-core chip and 1GB RAM for smooth emulation
    Expandable storage via MicroSD up to 256GB
    Custom firmware friendly (ArkOS) with USB-C Wi-Fi dongle support for multiplayer
    3200mAh battery for around 6 hours of play

    🚚 Shipping

    Free tracked shipping on every order to the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Orders are processed within 1 to 2 business days and ship directly from our supplier. See our Shipping Policy for full details.
